label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter flows directly into Base64 encode then decode cycle which preserves all characters including script tags, resulting in unsanitized user content being written to HTTP response via printf. The X-XSS-Protection header set to '0' disables browser protections, confirming intentional XSS exposure.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via getParameter flows through Base64 round-trip (encode then decode) preserving malicious scripts, then passed to printf sink writing to response writer
